As a Thai citizen, you're normally visa-free in Vietnam for up to 30 days under the Thailand-Vietnam bilateral agreement — but your planned 31-day trip exceeds that limit by one day, so the visa-free exemption won't cover the full stay. You'll need an e-Visa instead.

E-Visa details:
- Allows stays up to 90 days
- Cost: USD 25 (single entry) or USD 50 (multiple entry)
- Apply at https://evisa.gov.vn/
- Processing: 2-3 business days (expedited options available for a higher fee)
- Valid for entry by air, land, or sea at any of the approved ports (83 currently listed)

Other requirement: your passport must be valid for at least 180 days from your entry date.

Note: this data is current as of 2026-08-17 — please double-check the latest policy at evisa.gov.vn before you travel, since even a one-day overage like this is worth confirming directly.
